'''Nordanaar''' (originally '''Turtle WoW''') is an RP-PvE server, and the original Turtle WoW server prior to the launching of the [[Server:Hogger SEA|Hogger]] and [[Server:Ravenshire SEA|Ravenshire]] servers, soon followed by the launching of the [[Server:Emerald Dream SEA|Emerald Dream]] and [[Server:Tel'Abim EU|Tel'Abim]] servers.
